foundationFamilies.purpose: Solid and tuned-alpha color primitives for foundation and semantic token definitions.
Typography family, size, weight, line-height, and tracking primitives.
Spacing primitives for gaps, padding, and margins.
Shared numeric values used by foundation effect and geometry mappings.
Border-radius primitives for square and exceptional circular geometry.
Text-case primitives for authored typography variants.
Text-decoration primitives for authored typography variants.
Opacity primitives for transitions and structural visibility mechanics, using 000 through 100 steps; semantic states use explicit color roles.
Blur primitives corresponding to the approved Figma blur effect styles.
Composite focus and invalid perimeter effects corresponding to the Figma ring styles.
Fast duration and easing primitives for subtle visual state feedback.
Named responsive tiers and approved global canvas maximums.
Numeric stacking primitives used by semantic z-index aliases.

components.name: Typography
components.purpose: Formats document text, code, quotations, keyboard notation, and lists.
components.useWhen: Use Typography for normal document hierarchy and readable prose.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Typography classes to imitate controls or status.
components.fallback: Native HTML remains complete without JavaScript.
components.nativeBasis: Native HTML text elements keep document semantics and reading order.
components.description: Formats document text, code, quotations, keyboard notation, and lists.

components.name: Layout
components.purpose: Creates intrinsic containers, stacks, grids, sidebar splits, centering, and opposite-end groups.
components.useWhen: Use Layout for local page and component composition.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Layout as a replacement for App Shell or a complete shell.
components.fallback: Use normal document flow when no layout helper is necessary.
components.nativeBasis: CSS Grid and Flexbox provide intrinsic local composition.
components.description: Creates intrinsic containers, stacks, grids, sidebar splits, centering, and opposite-end groups.

components.name: Separator
components.purpose: Marks a real visual or semantic division.
components.useWhen: Use Separator for a topic break or a labelled structural split.
components.avoidWhen: Do not add a separator only to decorate empty space.
components.fallback: Keep the content adjacent when no real division exists.
components.nativeBasis: Use `<hr>` for horizontal rules and `role="separator"` for documented vertical divisions.
components.description: Marks a real visual or semantic division.

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: Presents a local Remix Icon glyph inside text or a control.
components.useWhen: Use Icon to support a visible label or a familiar icon-only action.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use an icon as the only status explanation.
components.fallback: Use text without an icon when the glyph adds no value.
components.nativeBasis: Inline local SVG is the complete native basis.
components.description: Presents a local Remix Icon glyph inside text or a control.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Starts an action, submits a form, or styles a navigation link as a button.
components.useWhen: Use a button for an action and an anchor for navigation.
components.avoidWhen: Do not put a navigation destination on a button element.
components.fallback: Use native button or link behavior without a component runtime.
components.nativeBasis: `<button>` provides action behavior and `<a>` provides navigation behavior.
components.description: Starts an action, submits a form, or styles a navigation link as a button.

components.name: Toggle
components.purpose: Changes one independent pressed state.
components.useWhen: Use Toggle for formatting controls and independent two-state tools.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Toggle for a submitted form setting when Checkbox or Switch matches the task.
components.fallback: Use Checkbox or Switch when a native submitted control is required.
components.nativeBasis: `<button aria-pressed>` provides activation semantics while the module synchronizes pressed state.
components.description: Changes one independent pressed state.

components.name: Toggle Group
components.purpose: Coordinates a set of related pressed buttons.
components.useWhen: Use Toggle Group for one or several choices in a compact toolbar.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Toggle Group when native radio or checkbox controls fit the form task.
components.fallback: Use Radio Group or Checkbox Group for native form submission.
components.nativeBasis: A labelled button group uses `aria-pressed` and roving focus.
components.description: Coordinates a set of related pressed buttons.

components.name: Button Group
components.purpose: Connects related buttons into one visual control group.
components.useWhen: Use Button Group when adjacent actions share one task or object.
components.avoidWhen: Do not group unrelated actions only to save space.
components.fallback: Use independent buttons when the actions are not one group.
components.nativeBasis: Native buttons keep their own activation and form behavior.
components.description: Connects related buttons into one visual control group.

components.name: Toolbar
components.purpose: Groups frequently used controls with managed arrow-key navigation.
components.useWhen: Use Toolbar for a compact row of related application controls.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Toolbar for normal form fields or route navigation.
components.fallback: Use a normal control group when arrow-key navigation is not necessary.
components.nativeBasis: `role="toolbar"` groups controls while the module manages roving focus.
components.description: Groups frequently used controls with managed arrow-key navigation.

components.name: Label
components.purpose: Names one native form control.
components.useWhen: Use Label with an explicit `for` and `id` pair.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use placeholder text as the only control name.
components.fallback: Use another visible naming element only when the control cannot use `<label>`.
components.nativeBasis: `<label>` provides the native control association.
components.description: Names one native form control.

components.name: Field
components.purpose: Composes a label, native control, help text, error text, and related fieldsets.
components.useWhen: Use Field as the standard wrapper for form controls and control groups.
components.avoidWhen: Do not add an unnamed group role around one control.
components.fallback: Use the native control directly when no supporting composition is needed.
components.nativeBasis: Native labels, fieldsets, validation, submission, and reset remain authoritative.
components.description: Composes a label, native control, help text, error text, and related fieldsets.

components.name: Text Field
components.purpose: Collects one line of text with labels, descriptions, icons, and validation.
components.useWhen: Use Text Field for text, email, password, search, URL, and similar native input types.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Text Field for multi-line content or fixed option selection.
components.fallback: Use the raw native input when the composition needs no shared styling.
components.nativeBasis: A labelled native `<input>` owns editing, autofill, validation, and events.
components.description: Collects one line of text with labels, descriptions, icons, and validation.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Collects multi-line text.
components.useWhen: Use Textarea when the user can enter more than one line.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Textarea for a short fixed-format value.
components.fallback: Use Text Field for one-line input.
components.nativeBasis: Native `<textarea>` owns editing and validation.
components.description: Collects multi-line text.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Selects one independent option or several independent options.
components.useWhen: Use Checkbox for submitted choices and select-all groups.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Checkbox for one immediate system state when Switch communicates the effect better.
components.fallback: Use native checkboxes without the group enhancement.
components.nativeBasis: Native checkbox state remains authoritative and the optional module coordinates documented groups.
components.description: Selects one independent option or several independent options.

components.name: Radio Group
components.purpose: Selects one value from a visible set.
components.useWhen: Use Radio Group when the options are short and all options should remain visible.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Radio Group for independent choices or a very long option set.
components.fallback: Use Select for a compact fixed list.
components.nativeBasis: Native radio inputs share selection through a common `name` inside a fieldset.
components.description: Selects one value from a visible set.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: Changes an immediate binary system state.
components.useWhen: Use Switch when activation takes effect immediately.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Switch for a value that takes effect only after form submission.
components.fallback: Use Checkbox for a submitted choice.
components.nativeBasis: A native checkbox with switch semantics owns focus, state, and submission.
components.description: Changes an immediate binary system state.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Selects a value from a continuous or stepped numeric range.
components.useWhen: Use Slider when spatial adjustment helps the user understand the value.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Slider when precise text entry is the only useful path.
components.fallback: Use Number Field when exact numeric entry is primary.
components.nativeBasis: Native range input owns pointer and keyboard adjustment while the module updates documented output.
components.description: Selects a value from a continuous or stepped numeric range.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Selects one or several values from a fixed native option list.
components.useWhen: Use Select for a short or medium fixed option set.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Select when the user needs to search a long list.
components.fallback: Use Combobox when search is required.
components.nativeBasis: Native `<select>` owns the picker, keyboard behavior, and form submission.
components.description: Selects one or several values from a fixed native option list.

components.name: Number Field
components.purpose: Collects a numeric value with explicit increment and decrement controls.
components.useWhen: Use Number Field when small step changes are common.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Number Field when a range or free text input communicates the task better.
components.fallback: Use native number input without step buttons when the extra controls are unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: Native number input owns validation while the module coordinates step buttons.
components.description: Collects a numeric value with explicit increment and decrement controls.

components.name: File Input
components.purpose: Opens the native file picker.
components.useWhen: Use File Input when the user must choose one or more local files.
components.avoidWhen: Do not create a custom file picker that hides the native input contract.
components.fallback: Use native file input without additional composition.
components.nativeBasis: Native file input owns selection, security, and form submission.
components.description: Opens the native file picker.

components.name: Date Field
components.purpose: Collects a date or local date and time with the browser control.
components.useWhen: Use Date Field when the browser picker meets the task.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Date Field when the interface requires a controlled month grid or date-range preview.
components.fallback: Use Date Picker only when a custom visible calendar is required.
components.nativeBasis: Native date input owns parsing, picker behavior, and validation.
components.description: Collects a date or local date and time with the browser control.

components.name: Date Picker
components.purpose: Selects a date from a custom accessible month grid.
components.useWhen: Use Date Picker when the product requires a consistent visible calendar.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Date Picker when a native Date Field is sufficient.
components.fallback: Use Date Field when a no-JavaScript date selector is required.
components.nativeBasis: A grid-based month view uses managed keyboard navigation and selection.
components.description: Selects a date from a custom accessible month grid.

components.name: Date Range Picker
components.purpose: Collects a start date and an end date with native inputs.
components.useWhen: Use Date Range Picker for a submitted interval that benefits from a shared summary.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Date Range Picker for one date or a custom calendar grid.
components.fallback: Use the two native date inputs without cross-field enhancement.
components.nativeBasis: Two native date inputs remain usable while the optional module validates their relationship.
components.description: Collects a start date and an end date with native inputs.

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: Selects one option from a searchable list.
components.useWhen: Use Combobox when a long option set needs search and keyboard selection.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Combobox for free text or a short fixed list.
components.fallback: Use Select when a no-JavaScript selection path is required.
components.nativeBasis: A button opens a searchable listbox popover and the module manages selection and form-value synchronization.
components.description: Selects one option from a searchable list.

components.name: Time Field
components.purpose: Collects a structured time from native numeric fields and a period selector.
components.useWhen: Use Time Field when separate time segments improve entry and validation.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Time Field when a native time input is the simpler contract.
components.fallback: Use the native segment controls without synchronization or use a native time input.
components.nativeBasis: Native controls remain usable while the optional module synchronizes the submitted value.
components.description: Collects a structured time from native numeric fields and a period selector.

components.name: Form
components.purpose: Composes a complete native submission task.
components.useWhen: Use Form for one coherent submit and validation flow.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Form as a visual wrapper when no submission exists.
components.fallback: Use semantic page sections when no form submission exists.
components.nativeBasis: Native form submission, reset, and constraint validation remain authoritative.
components.description: Composes a complete native submission task.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Shows short non-interactive status or metadata.
components.useWhen: Use Badge for a concise label that supplements nearby content.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Badge as a button, link, or sole status explanation.
components.fallback: Use plain text when no badge emphasis is necessary.
components.nativeBasis: Ordinary text semantics remain available inside the visual badge.
components.description: Shows short non-interactive status or metadata.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Shows a person or entity image with a fallback and optional status.
components.useWhen: Use Avatar when identity recognition helps the task.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Avatar as a decorative circle without identity meaning.
components.fallback: Use initials or visible identity text when image fallback behavior is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: Image and fallback content present identity while the module handles documented fallback behavior.
components.description: Shows a person or entity image with a fallback and optional status.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Groups one standalone object or a small related content set.
components.useWhen: Use Card when the group must read as one independent object.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Card as the default wrapper for sections, tables, rows, forms, or other cards.
components.fallback: Use App Section or normal document flow for page regions.
components.nativeBasis: The chosen semantic container keeps its normal document meaning.
components.description: Groups one standalone object or a small related content set.

components.name: Image
components.purpose: Presents an image, caption, fallback, and optional larger preview.
components.useWhen: Use Image when visual content carries information.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Image when a CSS decoration has no content meaning.
components.fallback: Use a plain `
components.nativeBasis: Figure and image semantics remain primary while the module adds the documented preview.
components.description: Presents an image, caption, fallback, and optional larger preview.

components.name: Statistic
components.purpose: Shows one value with a label, description, and optional trend.
components.useWhen: Use Statistic for a small summary that helps the next decision.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Statistic for a value already obvious in the primary data view.
components.fallback: Use plain text or table cells when the value belongs in a larger data structure.
components.nativeBasis: Static semantic text presents the metric without runtime behavior.
components.description: Shows one value with a label, description, and optional trend.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Presents data with stable row and column relationships.
components.useWhen: Use Table when headers define the meaning of cells.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Table for general page layout.
components.fallback: Use lists or definition lists when data is not tabular.
components.nativeBasis: Native table semantics expose captions and header relationships.
components.description: Presents data with stable row and column relationships.

components.name: Data Table
components.purpose: Adds filtering, sorting, status, and pagination around Table.
components.useWhen: Use Data Table when the documented data controls are necessary.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Data Table when a static Table meets the task.
components.fallback: Use Table with server-owned forms and links.
components.nativeBasis: The semantic table and native links remain usable while the optional module adds client behavior.
components.description: Adds filtering, sorting, status, and pagination around Table.

components.name: Collapsible
components.purpose: Reveals and hides supplementary content.
components.useWhen: Use Collapsible for optional detail that can remain closed.
components.avoidWhen: Do not hide required instructions or primary actions in a disclosure.
components.fallback: Keep the content visible when hiding it does not improve the task.
components.nativeBasis: Native `<details>` and `<summary>` provide the disclosure behavior.
components.description: Reveals and hides supplementary content.

components.name: Timeline
components.purpose: Presents events or steps in chronological or procedural order.
components.useWhen: Use Timeline when sequence is the main relationship.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Timeline for an unordered status list.
components.fallback: Use a normal list when order is not the main meaning.
components.nativeBasis: An ordered list preserves sequence without runtime behavior.
components.description: Presents events or steps in chronological or procedural order.

components.name: Tree View
components.purpose: Presents hierarchical items with expandable branches.
components.useWhen: Use Tree View when parent and child structure must remain visible.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Tree View for a flat route list or ordinary disclosure list.
components.fallback: Use nested lists and details when managed tree navigation is not required.
components.nativeBasis: A tree pattern exposes hierarchy while the module manages branch navigation and roving focus.
components.description: Presents hierarchical items with expandable branches.

components.name: Carousel
components.purpose: Presents a sequence of slides in a bounded scroll region.
components.useWhen: Use Carousel when sequential visual items must share one space.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Carousel for required content that should remain visible in a normal list.
components.fallback: Use a normal list or horizontal scroll region when controls are not required.
components.nativeBasis: Native scrolling remains available while the module coordinates controls and active indicators.
components.description: Presents a sequence of slides in a bounded scroll region.

components.name: Scroll Area
components.purpose: Contains overflow inside a bounded region.
components.useWhen: Use Scroll Area when a local region must scroll independently.
components.avoidWhen: Do not create nested scrolling when normal page flow works.
components.fallback: Use normal document scrolling.
components.nativeBasis: Native overflow and browser scrollbars provide the behavior.
components.description: Contains overflow inside a bounded region.

components.name: Sortable
components.purpose: Reorders a user-owned list.
components.useWhen: Use Sortable when item order changes meaning or execution.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Sortable when order is fixed or when drag would be the only path.
components.fallback: Use explicit move controls or a fixed list when reorder interaction is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: The module supports drag, keyboard movement, and announced position changes.
components.description: Reorders a user-owned list.

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: Shows that an indeterminate task is active.
components.useWhen: Use Spinner for short active work with an accompanying status name.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Spinner for decoration or known completion.
components.fallback: Use Progress when completion is known or text status when motion adds no value.
components.nativeBasis: CSS rotation provides the single sanctioned animation.
components.description: Shows that an indeterminate task is active.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Reserves the shape of content that is loading.
components.useWhen: Use Skeleton when the final structure is known and the placeholder prevents layout shift.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Skeleton for unknown content or as an animated effect.
components.fallback: Keep existing content visible or use a text loading status.
components.nativeBasis: Static decorative shapes remain hidden from assistive technology.
components.description: Reserves the shape of content that is loading.

components.name: Progress
components.purpose: Shows known task completion.
components.useWhen: Use Progress when the system knows the current value and maximum.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Progress for an indeterminate task.
components.fallback: Use Spinner or status text for indeterminate work.
components.nativeBasis: Native `<progress>` exposes the bounded completion value.
components.description: Shows known task completion.

components.name: Callout
components.purpose: Presents persistent important information in the page flow.
components.useWhen: Use Callout for guidance, warning, success, or error content that remains visible.
components.avoidWhen: Do not add a live alert role to static information.
components.fallback: Use normal prose when emphasis is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: Normal semantic content remains in flow unless an urgent dynamic role is explicitly required.
components.description: Presents persistent important information in the page flow.

components.name: Alert Dialog
components.purpose: Requires an explicit response to a high-impact decision.
components.useWhen: Use Alert Dialog for destructive or blocking confirmation.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Alert Dialog for low-risk information or an easy undo.
components.fallback: Use Dialog for neutral modal tasks or inline undo for low-risk actions.
components.nativeBasis: Native modal dialog behavior combines with explicit alert-dialog semantics and scripted trigger coordination.
components.description: Requires an explicit response to a high-impact decision.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Announces a brief non-blocking result.
components.useWhen: Use Toast for a short status that does not require a decision.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Toast for a blocking error or essential instructions.
components.fallback: Use Callout for persistent content or Dialog for blocking decisions.
components.nativeBasis: A manual popover and polite live status provide non-blocking feedback.
components.description: Announces a brief non-blocking result.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Shows non-modal contextual content in the top layer.
components.useWhen: Use Popover for a small surface that relates to one trigger.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Popover for a blocking task or large form.
components.fallback: Keep content inline when a top-layer surface is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: Native Popover API supplies top-layer and light-dismiss behavior while the module coordinates documented positioning.
components.description: Shows non-modal contextual content in the top layer.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Shows a short supplementary hint on hover and focus.
components.useWhen: Use Tooltip to clarify an unfamiliar icon or terse control.
components.avoidWhen: Do not place essential instructions only in a tooltip.
components.fallback: Use visible helper text when the information is required.
components.nativeBasis: A hint popover provides supplementary text for hover and keyboard focus.
components.description: Shows a short supplementary hint on hover and focus.

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: Contains a focused modal task.
components.useWhen: Use Dialog for a task that must temporarily block the page.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Dialog for ordinary page content or a simple status.
components.fallback: Use inline content when blocking the page is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: Native modal dialog behavior provides the top layer while the module coordinates triggers and focus restoration.
components.description: Contains a focused modal task.

components.name: Sheet
components.purpose: Presents an edge-aligned modal task.
components.useWhen: Use Sheet when the task benefits from a persistent edge orientation.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Sheet only to imitate a fashionable panel.
components.fallback: Use Dialog when edge alignment does not improve the task.
components.nativeBasis: Native modal dialog behavior provides the blocking surface while CSS applies the documented edge.
components.description: Presents an edge-aligned modal task.

components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Groups several disclosure sections.
components.useWhen: Use Accordion when users can inspect one or several optional sections.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Accordion for primary sequential content that should remain visible.
components.fallback: Use independent Collapsible elements or visible sections.
components.nativeBasis: Native details elements support multi-open behavior and the optional module coordinates single-open behavior.
components.description: Groups several disclosure sections.

components.name: Command Palette
components.purpose: Finds and activates global application commands.
components.useWhen: Use Command Palette for a large command set that benefits from search.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Command Palette as the only route to normal navigation or common actions.
components.fallback: Use visible buttons, menus, or navigation for common actions.
components.nativeBasis: A native modal dialog contains search and commands while the module manages filtering and activation.
components.description: Finds and activates global application commands.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.purpose: Shows the current route within a hierarchy.
components.useWhen: Use Breadcrumbs when parent routes help orientation or navigation.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Breadcrumbs on a flat site or as a page title replacement.
components.fallback: Use the page title alone when parent-route context adds no value.
components.nativeBasis: Native links inside an ordered navigation list expose the hierarchy.
components.description: Shows the current route within a hierarchy.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Moves between result pages.
components.useWhen: Use Pagination when the result set has stable page URLs.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Pagination for a small list or an in-page tab switch.
components.fallback: Use one continuous result list when paging is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: Native links preserve navigation, history, and no-JavaScript use.
components.description: Moves between result pages.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Switches among related panels within one route.
components.useWhen: Use Tabs when panels are peers and only one panel is active.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Tabs for application routes or sequential steps.
components.fallback: Use route links for navigation or visible sections when simultaneous access is better.
components.nativeBasis: ARIA tab roles expose the panel relationship while the module manages selection and roving focus.
components.description: Switches among related panels within one route.

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.purpose: Shows a compact set of actions from one trigger.
components.useWhen: Use Dropdown Menu when visible buttons would create excessive local clutter.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Dropdown Menu for primary site navigation or form option selection.
components.fallback: Use visible buttons when the action set is small.
components.nativeBasis: A popover menu exposes action items while the module manages the menu keyboard model.
components.description: Shows a compact set of actions from one trigger.

components.name: Navigation Menu
components.purpose: Groups related site routes in top-level navigation popovers.
components.useWhen: Use Navigation Menu when a route group is too large for flat top navigation.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Navigation Menu for application actions or a small route set.
components.fallback: Use flat route links when the route set fits.
components.nativeBasis: Semantic navigation links remain routes while popovers expose grouped destinations.
components.description: Groups related site routes in top-level navigation popovers.

components.name: App Shell
components.purpose: Provides reusable application header, toolbar, page overview, content, status, and empty-state primitives.
components.useWhen: Use App Shell to compose shared application chrome and utility page regions.
components.avoidWhen: Do not treat App Shell as a complete route template or business-content component.
components.fallback: Use semantic page landmarks directly when shared shell styling is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: Semantic landmarks and page regions work without JavaScript while the optional module adds theme persistence.
components.description: Provides reusable application header, toolbar, page overview, content, status, and empty-state primitives.

components.name: Sidebar
components.purpose: Provides collapsible desktop navigation and a mobile navigation dialog.
components.useWhen: Use Sidebar for applications with persistent route navigation.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Sidebar for a small flat site that fits top navigation.
components.fallback: Use top-level route links when persistent sidebar navigation is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: Semantic aside and nav content combine with a native mobile dialog while the module manages collapse state.
components.description: Provides collapsible desktop navigation and a mobile navigation dialog.

components.name: Resizable
components.purpose: Presents two panels with an optional adjustable separator.
components.useWhen: Use Resizable when changing the split improves a repeated work task.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Resizable for decorative balance or when a static split is sufficient.
components.fallback: Use a static CSS split when user-controlled resizing adds no value.
components.nativeBasis: A static separator remains understandable while the optional module adds pointer and keyboard resizing.
components.description: Presents two panels with an optional adjustable separator.

components.name: Color Picker
components.purpose: Selects a color through a native picker with optional editable hexadecimal synchronization.
components.useWhen: Use Color Picker when a user needs both visual color selection and an exact color value.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Color Picker when the task accepts only a small fixed palette.
components.fallback: Use a native color input alone when editable hexadecimal entry adds no value.
components.nativeBasis: A native color input remains usable while the optional module synchronizes an editable hexadecimal field.
components.description: Selects a color through a native picker with optional editable hexadecimal synchronization.

components.name: File Upload
components.purpose: Selects files with optional drag-and-drop feedback, file details, and image previews.
components.useWhen: Use File Upload when drag and drop or selected-file feedback improves native file selection.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use File Upload when a compact native File Input is sufficient.
components.fallback: Use File Input for simple local file selection.
components.nativeBasis: A labelled native file input preserves selection and submission while the optional module adds drop handling and previews.
components.description: Selects files with optional drag-and-drop feedback, file details, and image previews.

components.name: Input OTP
components.purpose: Captures a fixed-length one-time code through segmented native inputs.
components.useWhen: Use Input OTP when a short verification code benefits from visible character positions.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Input OTP for passwords, recovery keys, or variable-length values.
components.fallback: Use one Text Field when segmentation does not improve entry.
components.nativeBasis: Native text inputs preserve entry while the optional module adds focus movement and distributed paste.
components.description: Captures a fixed-length one-time code through segmented native inputs.

components.name: Tag Input
components.purpose: Commits free text into discrete removable values.
components.useWhen: Use Tag Input when a form accepts several short freeform labels.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Tag Input for one fixed choice or a long searchable option set.
components.fallback: Use a Text Field with a documented delimiter when discrete editing is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: A native text input preserves entry while the optional module renders committed values and synchronized hidden inputs.
components.description: Commits free text into discrete removable values.

components.name: Header
components.purpose: Provides a reusable banner landmark for brand, primary navigation, and global actions.
components.useWhen: Use Header when several routes share the same top-level banner structure.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Header as a generic wrapper inside page content.
components.fallback: Use a native header landmark directly when shared component styling is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: A native header provides the banner landmark and remains complete without JavaScript.
components.description: Provides a reusable banner landmark for brand, primary navigation, and global actions.

components.name: Nav
components.purpose: Presents a small flat route set with explicit current-page state.
components.useWhen: Use Nav when a short route set fits without nested disclosure.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Nav for actions, peer panels, or a large persistent application route tree.
components.fallback: Use plain links without shared styling when a navigation component adds no value.
components.nativeBasis: A labelled native navigation landmark and links preserve routing without JavaScript.
components.description: Presents a small flat route set with explicit current-page state.

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: Provides a reusable content-information landmark for secondary routes and service metadata.
components.useWhen: Use Footer when several routes share the same closing navigation or service information.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Footer for primary actions or unrelated page content.
components.fallback: Use a native footer landmark directly when shared component styling is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: A native footer provides the content-information landmark and remains complete without JavaScript.
components.description: Provides a reusable content-information landmark for secondary routes and service metadata.

components.name: Context Menu
components.purpose: Shows a compact action menu at a pointer context position or from a keyboard trigger.
components.useWhen: Use Context Menu when the same local actions benefit from right-click and keyboard access.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Context Menu as the only way to reach an essential action.
components.fallback: Use Dropdown Menu when a visible trigger is the primary access path.
components.nativeBasis: A popover menu provides the surface while the module manages context positioning and the menu keyboard model.
components.description: Shows a compact action menu at a pointer context position or from a keyboard trigger.

components.name: Hover Card
components.purpose: Shows a rich supplementary preview from pointer hover or keyboard focus.
components.useWhen: Use Hover Card when a linked subject benefits from optional preview content.
components.avoidWhen: Do not place required instructions or primary actions only in Hover Card.
components.fallback: Use Tooltip for a short hint or visible content when the information is essential.
components.nativeBasis: A non-modal popover provides the preview while the module coordinates hover, focus, dismissal, and positioning.
components.description: Shows a rich supplementary preview from pointer hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: Agent Activity
components.purpose: Presents one chronological stream of assistant reasoning, searches, tool calls, and related steps.
components.useWhen: Use Agent Activity when several assistant operations need one ordered execution history.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Agent Activity for a single status or an unordered event feed.
components.fallback: Use Tool Call for one operation or Timeline for non-assistant events.
components.nativeBasis: An ordered list preserves activity sequence without component JavaScript.
components.description: Presents one chronological stream of assistant reasoning, searches, tool calls, and related steps.

components.name: Code Block
components.purpose: Presents code with an optional copy action, line numbers, and stable streamed updates.
components.useWhen: Use Code Block when code needs controls or structure beyond a normal preformatted block.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Code Block for a short inline code term.
components.fallback: Use native pre and code elements when copy, numbering, and streaming support are unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: Native pre and code elements remain readable while the optional module adds copy and streamed-content coordination.
components.description: Presents code with an optional copy action, line numbers, and stable streamed updates.

components.name: Composer
components.purpose: Provides a message-entry form with an expanding textarea and optional leading and trailing actions.
components.useWhen: Use Composer for chat or assistant message entry.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Composer for a general multi-field form or a one-line search query.
components.fallback: Use Textarea and Button directly when the composed action surface adds no value.
components.nativeBasis: A native form and textarea preserve entry and submission while the optional module coordinates state and enhancement behavior.
components.description: Provides a message-entry form with an expanding textarea and optional leading and trailing actions.

components.name: File Diff
components.purpose: Presents file changes with metadata and semantic added, removed, and context lines.
components.useWhen: Use File Diff when line relationships and change type must remain scannable.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use File Diff for a whole file without comparison semantics.
components.fallback: Use Code Block for code that has no addition or removal relationship.
components.nativeBasis: A figure, optional native disclosure, and table preserve file and line relationships without JavaScript.
components.description: Presents file changes with metadata and semantic added, removed, and context lines.

components.name: Message
components.purpose: Presents an ordered conversation as authored rows with metadata and optional expansion.
components.useWhen: Use Message for chat transcripts where order and authorship carry meaning.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Message as a generic comment card or unordered feed.
components.fallback: Use a normal ordered list when authored message styling adds no value.
components.nativeBasis: An ordered list, list items, articles, and optional native details preserve transcript meaning without JavaScript.
components.description: Presents an ordered conversation as authored rows with metadata and optional expansion.

components.name: Message Scroller
components.purpose: Follows streamed conversation output at the live edge until the reader scrolls away.
components.useWhen: Use Message Scroller when a growing conversation should remain pinned only while the reader stays at its end.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Message Scroller for static content or to force a reader away from earlier content.
components.fallback: Use Scroll Area when live-edge following is unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: A labelled log region remains scrollable while the optional module coordinates live-edge following and return controls.
components.description: Follows streamed conversation output at the live edge until the reader scrolls away.

components.name: Reasoning
components.purpose: Presents an optional assistant reasoning trace with explicit streaming and complete states.
components.useWhen: Use Reasoning when a response may expose a concise reasoning or work trace.
components.avoidWhen: Do not place required answer content only inside Reasoning.
components.fallback: Use Collapsible for ordinary supplementary detail.
components.nativeBasis: Native details and summary preserve disclosure while the optional module coordinates streaming open state.
components.description: Presents an optional assistant reasoning trace with explicit streaming and complete states.

components.name: Sources
components.purpose: Connects inline citations with a readable list of external references.
components.useWhen: Use Sources for grounded answers and research summaries that cite navigable material.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Sources to present unrelated bookmarks or actions.
components.fallback: Use a normal link list when numbered inline citations are unnecessary.
components.nativeBasis: A labelled section, ordered list, and real links preserve citation navigation without JavaScript.
components.description: Connects inline citations with a readable list of external references.

components.name: Suggestion
components.purpose: Presents short prompt choices that can seed the next composer value.
components.useWhen: Use Suggestion near an empty composer when useful starts improve discovery.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Suggestion for route navigation or a long command catalog.
components.fallback: Use normal Buttons when the actions do not insert prompt text.
components.nativeBasis: An unordered list of native buttons preserves activation without component JavaScript.
components.description: Presents short prompt choices that can seed the next composer value.

components.name: Thinking Indicator
components.purpose: Communicates that an assistant is actively preparing a response.
components.useWhen: Use Thinking Indicator for a short indeterminate assistant state with a visible label.
components.avoidWhen: Do not leave Thinking Indicator visible after work stops.
components.fallback: Use Spinner for compact control-level work or Progress for known completion.
components.nativeBasis: A polite status region with visible text communicates work without component JavaScript.
components.description: Communicates that an assistant is actively preparing a response.

components.name: Todo List
components.purpose: Presents an ordered task plan with visible item status and completion context.
components.useWhen: Use Todo List when a user benefits from following an agent or process plan in execution order.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Todo List as a general checklist input.
components.fallback: Use a normal ordered list when task status does not change.
components.nativeBasis: Native details and an ordered list remain usable while the optional module derives completion from direct task items.
components.description: Presents an ordered task plan with visible item status and completion context.

components.name: Tool Call
components.purpose: Presents an assistant tool operation with visible status and optional result content.
components.useWhen: Use Tool Call for searches, file reads, code runs, and other discrete assistant operations.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Tool Call for an application action performed directly by the user.
components.fallback: Use Thinking Indicator for a general response state without a named operation.
components.nativeBasis: Native details and summary expose optional results while a status-only row remains plain semantic content.
components.description: Presents an assistant tool operation with visible status and optional result content.
